candidates.source_name: NLB Banka Kosovo - Ftesë për ofertim (tender invitations)
candidates.why_relevant: Systemic Kosovo bank publishing its own RFQ/RFP invitations, organised by year (2024-2026), including highly on-topic items: cash/coin counting and verification machines, UPS for the server room, LAN implementation, SWIFT CSCF assessment, AI document verification, archive document management software, safes. Direct visibility of private-bank IT/cash/self-service procurement that never reaches the public e-procurement portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML scrape of the year-grouped listing plus the 'Më shumë' detail pages; follow linked spec documents; also mirror the hr.nlb-kos.com news IDs (e.g. /news/629/ftese-ofertim) which carry the same notices. Contact channel for tender files: prokurimi@nlb-kos.com.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) + snowball from result titles
queries_used: "ftesë për ofertë" banka Kosovë tender furnizim NLB TEB BKT
NLB Banka Kosovo javne nabavke dobavljači tender ponuda

candidates.source_name: BKT Kosova - Tenderë archive (Kërkesë për Ofertë)
candidates.why_relevant: Dedicated WordPress custom-post-type tender archive of Banka Kombëtare Tregtare Kosova. Observed notices cover PC/monitor/laptop/phone supply, call-centre maintenance and configuration, pay-per-print services, safe (dropbox) purchase, marketing agency, fuel — i.e. a running feed of a top-5 Kosovo bank's IT and facilities buying. English mirror exists at /en/bkt_tenders/.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the bkt_tenders archive; WordPress CPT so a feed at /bkt_tenders/feed/ is worth probing. Fetch attempt returned a TLS chain error ('unable to verify the first certificate') — likely an incomplete intermediate chain rather than a dead site; a collector may need relaxed chain validation or a full CA bundle.

"ftesë për ofertë" banka Kosovë tender furnizim NLB TEB BKT

candidates.source_name: TEB Sh.A. (Kosovo) - Tenders page with RFQ/IFB/RFP PDFs
candidates.why_relevant: TEB (BNP Paribas / TEB Holding JV) publishes structured procurement notices explicitly typed RFQ / IFB / RFP with downloadable PDF tender documents, deadline-extension notices, and an archive. Observed subjects include generator supply, TVRA (threat & vulnerability risk assessment) for data centres, IT equipment and software, construction/renovation, security and facility management — the richest document-level detail of any Kosovo bank found in this cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape listing + archive, download linked PDFs, parse RFQ/IFB/RFP type, subject and deadline; track 'deadline extension' notices as a signal of scope changes. Albanian mirror at /al/ path family (see www.teb-kos.com/en/index.php/publikimet/tenderet legacy path).
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) then direct fetch of tenders page
queries_used: TEB Sh.A. Kosovë "ftesë për ofertim" OR tender furnizim prokurimi

candidates.source_name: Banka Ekonomike - Ankande dhe Shpallje (auctions and announcements)
candidates.why_relevant: Mixed feed of procurement invitations and collateral auctions from a fully domestic Kosovo bank. Search evidence points to a call for supply of POS and ATM receipt rolls, and the live page shows illuminated-signage supply/installation/servicing and generator rental — i.e. exactly the consumables/self-service/facilities layer that never appears on public portals. Offers are submitted in sealed envelopes at the Prishtina head office, so notices are the only public trace.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML scrape with date parsing; classify each item as procurement vs. collateral auction (the page mixes both). English mirror at bekonomike.com/en/.
queries_used: "Banka për Biznes" OR "Banka Ekonomike" Kosovë ftesë për ofertë tender furnizim

candidates.source_name: BPB (Banka për Biznes) - Ftesat për Ofertë
candidates.why_relevant: Domestic bank's call-for-offers page with downloadable tender documents. Live listings observed include bank premises renovation and — highly relevant to cash/self-service intelligence — security services covering cash-in-transit, physical guarding, monitoring centre and ATM management (bankomatët). ATM fleet management outsourcing is a strategic signal rarely visible elsewhere.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape listing and download the attached documents; the page lacked visible dates, so use first-seen timestamps from the crawler for change detection.

candidates.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo - Shpallje për tenderë (tender announcements hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Official procurement hub of the largest foreign-owned bank in Kosovo. Carries the bank's General Terms and Conditions for procurement (PDF) and the RBI Group Code of Conduct for Suppliers, and names the procurement contact prokurimi@raiffeisen-kosovo.com. The rules documents are as valuable as the notices: they define how a vendor can qualify and what the bank's award process looks like.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the page for notice items and archive the two PDFs (procurement general terms; RBI supplier code). At fetch time no active notice list was rendered — verify whether notices load via a JS component or are only distributed by email to registered vendors.
candidates.discovered_via_method: pointer snowball — footer navigation of the bank's About us page

candidates.source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosova - Business ethics / corporate pages (procurement-rules surface)
candidates.why_relevant: ProCredit Kosovo showed no dedicated tender page in any sq/en query, but the group states its tender procedure follows equal-competition and 'value for money' principles. The business-ethics/governance pages are the only public surface where ProCredit Kosovo's procurement rules and supplier expectations would be documented, and any future tender link would most plausibly appear in this section or under lajme/shpallje.

candidates.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International - Code of Conduct for Suppliers / group procurement governance
candidates.why_relevant: RBI Group Procurement (headed at group level) sets binding rules that Raiffeisen Kosovo applies, including anti-collusion clauses that forbid suppliers disclosing anything about planned, running or pending RBI Group procurements. That clause itself is intelligence: it explains why Raiffeisen Kosovo notices are thin publicly and why vendor-side sources will be silent. The RBI platform login page is the entry point to group vendor-facing platforms.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not attempt authenticated access. Track only the public supplier-code and procurement policy PDFs; use the RBI CZ supplier code (rb.cz/en/about-us/about-raiffeisenbank/eticky-kodex-dodavatelu) as a readable version of the group text.

negative_findings.description: ProCredit Bank Kosova (procreditbank-kos.com) has no discoverable tender, RFP or supplier-registration page. Site-scoped searches in Albanian ('ftesë për ofertë', 'shpallje', 'furnizim', 'tender') returned only product, pricing and news pages, while sibling ProCredit entities in Serbia, Georgia, Ukraine and Albania all expose /tenders paths.
negative_findings.result_summary: Kosovo entity appears to run procurement privately or via the holding, publishing nothing locally; a direct fetch of its business-ethics page also returned HTTP 500 (unverified, not dead).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ProCredit is a systemic Kosovo bank; if its RFPs are invisible, its IT/card/self-service buying can only be inferred from vendor announcements, group signals or interviews, leaving a real blind spot in A2 coverage.

negative_findings.description: Ziraat Bank Kosova SHA exposes no tender, procurement or supplier page; only a general 'Lajmërime/announcements' feed. Turkish-parent procurement terminology ('ihale') was not tested against the Kosovo domain because the site publishes only sq/en.
negative_findings.result_summary: No procurement surface located for Ziraat Kosovo.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A locally incorporated Turkish-parent bank undergoing legal transformation is likely to be buying systems now, invisibly.

negative_findings.description: No open group-level supplier-registration or e-sourcing portal was found for RBI (rbinternational.com resolves to a platform login), for NLB Group (no 'javna naročila'/'dobavitelji' portal on nlb.si or nlbgroup.com), or for ProCredit Holding. Searched in de/sl/sr/en.
negative_findings.result_summary: Foreign parents do not run public vendor portals reachable without authentication; RBI's supplier code even prohibits suppliers disclosing anything about pending group procurements.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed group procurement portals would be a route into Kosovo subsidiary buying; they are not. Collection must lean on local bank pages, vendor-side announcements and human sourcing.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language queries ('javne nabavke', 'dobavljači', 'tender ponuda') for Kosovo commercial banks returned Serbia-based portals (nbs.rs, nabavke.com, javne-nabavke.com, tenderbiro.rs) and no Kosovo bank content; the sole Kosovo hit was the Albanian NLB notice page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Kosovo commercial banks appear not to publish procurement notices in Serbian, even though it is an official language.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language monitoring for this cell should be reweighted toward North Kosovo / Serbia-facing media and vendor sources rather than bank tender pages; it is not a productive channel for bank RFPs.

negative_findings.description: None of the Kosovo bank tender pages examined (NLB, TEB, BKT, Banka Ekonomike, BPB, Raiffeisen) published award results, winning bidder names or contract values — only invitations, specifications and deadline extensions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Award-notice coverage for private bank procurement in Kosovo is effectively zero.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'award notices' topic in this run cannot be satisfied from private-buyer sources; outcomes must be reconstructed from vendor press releases, reference lists, LinkedIn and observed deployments.

negative_findings.description: bkt-ks.com returned a TLS chain error ('unable to verify the first certificate') on direct fetch, while its tender URLs are fully present in the search index.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot/TLS-configuration friction, not as a dead source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive collector would wrongly mark one of the richest tender feeds in the cell as unreachable.

coverage_gaps.description: Two licensed Kosovo banks in the cell — ProCredit Bank Kosova and Ziraat Bank Kosova — plus Türkiye İş Bankası Kosovo branch and PriBank have no located procurement surface at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a full sitemap/robots crawl of each domain in both sq and en trees for 'tender|ofert|furnizim|prokurim|shpallje|supplier|vendor'; probe group-pattern paths (/tenders, /sq/tender, /bkt_tenders analogues); if still empty, escalate to vendor-side and human sourcing and record the bank as a structurally dark buyer.

coverage_gaps.description: No source in this cell reveals who wins Kosovo bank contracts or at what value; the pipeline sees demand signals only, never awards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a vendor-side workstream: monitor supplier press rooms, reference/case-study pages, LinkedIn posts of Kosovo integrators, and CBK/bank annual reports for outsourcing disclosures, then join those to the RFP feed by subject and date.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language procurement terminology yielded no Kosovo bank sources, and Turkish procurement terminology ('ihale', 'satın alma', 'tedarikçi') was not exercised against the Turkish-parent banks (TEB, BKT, Ziraat, İş Bankası) which collectively form a large share of the market.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Turkish-language query set against teb.com.tr, bkt.com.al, ziraatbank.com.tr and their Kosovo domains; formally down-weight sr for bank tender discovery while keeping it for North Kosovo media.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank tender pages are rolling and mostly undated (BPB showed no dates at all); historical notices vanish or fall behind 'Më shumë' expanders and archive links, so backfill depth is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish first-seen timestamping in the collector from day one, expand all 'Më shumë'/archive controls during crawl, and cross-check depth against the Internet Archive for nlb-kos.com, bkt-ks.com, teb-kos.com and bekonomike.com.

coverage_gaps.description: The most valuable technical detail sits inside downloadable PDFs (TEB RFQ/IFB/RFP packs, BPB attachments) or is released only on request to procurement mailboxes, not in the HTML notice text.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build PDF ingestion and OCR into the collector for teb-kos.com and bpbbank.com attachments; explicitly forbid requesting bid dossiers by email, and record request-only tenders as metadata-only records.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unconfirmed whether Kosovo job/announcement portals and print classifieds (Koha Ditore, Zëri, Bota Sot) actually republish commercial-bank 'ftesë për ofertë' notices, which would be the main fallback for banks with no tender page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a two-week measurement: crawl portalpune.com, konkursi.net and major daily classifieds for bank-name plus tender keywords and compute overlap with the known bank feeds; keep the layer only if it surfaces notices the bank sites do not.

brief: Kosovo's commercial banks are private buyers outside the public e-procurement regime, yet five of them publish their own Albanian-language solicitations on their websites: NLB Banka ('Ftesë për ofertim', year-grouped, covering cash-counting machines, UPS, LAN and SWIFT CSCF work), TEB (a genuine RFQ/IFB/RFP page with downloadable PDF packs and deadline extensions), BKT Kosova (a WordPress 'Tenderë' archive), Banka Ekonomike ('Ankande dhe Shpallje', including POS/ATM consumables) and BPB ('Ftesat për Ofertë', including ATM management and cash-in-transit). Raiffeisen Kosovo maintains a procurement hub that publishes its general terms and the RBI supplier code plus a prokurimi@ contact, but showed no live notice list; ProCredit Kosova and Ziraat Kosova publish nothing procurement-related at all, and no open group-level supplier portal exists for RBI, NLB Group or ProCredit Holding — RBI's supplier code actively forbids disclosure of pending group procurements. Serbian-language searching produced no Kosovo bank procurement content, so sq is the working language of this cell with en as a secondary mirror. The structural limit is outcomes: these sources reveal demand (what banks are about to buy) but never awards, winners or values, so award-side intelligence must be reconstructed from vendor-side and reporting sources in another workstream.
